# Color Palette Generator

> A professional-grade color palette generator with advanced harmony algorithms, accessibility checking, and color blindness simulation. Built with React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

## Overview

Color Palette Generator is a web application that helps designers and developers create beautiful, accessible color palettes. It features advanced color harmony algorithms (complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary, monochromatic), accessibility checking with WCAG contrast ratios, and color blindness simulation.

## Key Features

- Color palette generation with multiple harmony types
- Accessibility checker with WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratio validation
- Color blindness simulator (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia)
- Curated palette library with over 2,100 palettes across 25 categories
- Color converter (HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, OKLCH)
- Lightbox palette viewer
- Theme-aware dark/light mode
